design_decisions: Page SQL is constructed only from the one StatementService span, with the final terminator removed and LIMIT/OFFSET bound as parameters outside the captured statement.
Pagination is an optional DuckDB adapter capability, leaving ExecutionEngine unchanged so Spark cannot advertise support accidentally.
PageController owns an independent QThread and cancellation-handle publication barrier; it never routes through QueryController or records history/messages.
Every editor tab keeps its own page state. A page result must match the base request, requested offset, captured page size, and a pending tab operation before it can replace the displayed frame.

Known totals impose an additional upper bound but never initiate a count. A page probe is the authoritative availability signal, so it can disable Next when a stale or contradictory total says otherwise. Preview and selection export use the displayed page, while full export receives the original captured request.
deferred_and_unverified: Manual desktop interaction with a disposable seven-row CSV, source mutation, and preview/full file inspection remains unverified because this implementation session has no interactive graphical display.
Very large offsets, Spark pagination, keyset pagination, and restart persistence remain intentionally out of scope. Count All Rows coexistence is implemented and covered by this review round.
